# Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery Corp.

Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery Corp. is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery provides reliable white glove delivery backed by a trusted 3PL warehouse. They offer secure logistics across the U.S. Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery Corp. employs 541 people (+7.6% YoY, +38 people) and has an annual revenue of $12.6M, founded in 1989. Headquartered in Perth Amboy, New Jersey, United States, with offices including Tampa, Minneapolis, Houston, Miami, and Spokane. Its workforce is distributed across 10 countries (including Pakistan, United States, El Salvador, Philippines, and Canada).

## About

.Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery is a leading provider of white-glove delivery services to E-Commerce retailers, furniture vendors, designers, and manufacturers. Founded in 1989 by Shawn Khan, Metropolitan has 44 strategically located facilities across the United States.

 Exclusive to the furniture industry, Metropolitan offers more than 2.8 million square feet of warehouse space along with a real-time warehouse management monitoring system. By using the latest in automation and technology, Metropolitan reduces transit times and delivers to every address in the continental United States. Now celebrating 35-years of serving the furniture industry, Metropolitan’s commitment to providing its customers with the very best delivery experience is unwavering.

# Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery Corp - PK

Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery Corp - PK is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery provides reliable white glove delivery backed by a trusted 3PL warehouse. They offer secure logistics across the U.S. Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery Corp - PK employs 90 people (+36.4% YoY, +24 people), founded in 1989. Headquartered in Perth Amboy, New Jersey, United States, with presence in Pakistan. Its workforce is distributed across Pakistan, United Kingdom, Sri Lanka, and United States.

## About

Established in 1989, Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery (MWD) is a leading provider of premier White Glove furniture delivery services in the USA. With operations in 44 cities across the USA and a dedicated team of over 1,200 professionals, MWD specializes in ECommerce furniture delivery, warehousing, and comprehensive white-glove delivery solutions. The company boasts more than 3.2 million square feet of warehouse space and utilizes cutting-edge technology for real-time logistics management, ensuring efficiency and customer satisfaction. With over three decades of experience, MWD consistently excels in delivering exceptional service, driven by a commitment to industry-leading performance.

MWD extends its global presence with offices in the United States, El Salvador, Pakistan, and the Philippines. Established in 2006 MWD’s Pakistan subsidiary MSPL supports Metropolitan's USA operations. MSPL employs over 200 professionals in areas such as Accounting & Finance, Supply Chain, IT, Customer Services, and Data Analytics. As an accredited Gold-status ACCA (UK) employer, MSPL is dedicated to youth development through internships and a specialized Management Trainee Officers program, underscoring its strong commitment to social responsibility.

properties.description:
Established in 1989, Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery (MWD) is a leading provider of premier White Glove furniture delivery services in the USA. With operations in 44 cities across the USA and a dedicated team of over 1,200 professionals, MWD specializes in ECommerce furniture delivery, warehousing, and comprehensive white-glove delivery solutions. The company boasts more than 3.2 million square feet of warehouse space and utilizes cutting-edge technology for real-time logistics management, ensuring efficiency and customer satisfaction. With over three decades of experience, MWD consistently excels in delivering exceptional service, driven by a commitment to industry-leading performance.

MWD extends its global presence with offices in the United States, El Salvador, Pakistan, and the Philippines. Established in 2006 MWD’s Pakistan subsidiary MSPL supports Metropolitan's USA operations. MSPL employs over 200 professionals in areas such as Accounting & Finance, Supply Chain, IT, Customer Services, and Data Analytics. As an accredited Gold-status ACCA (UK) employer, MSPL is dedicated to youth development through internships and a specialized Management Trainee Officers program, underscoring its strong commitment to social responsibility.
